release_notes:
Importing shows what a file contains before anything is saved: new snippets, triggers you already use, new folders and disabled snippets. Choose whether to be asked about each used trigger, skip those snippets, or import them with a new trigger such as _sig2

When you are asked about a used trigger, you can now do the same for all the remaining ones. New triggers continue a trailing number, so _reply1 becomes _reply2

The Backup card shows when you last backed up and to which file, and when Snippets last saved its automatic daily copy, with a link to that folder. Storage shows the size of your database

Backup files are released straight away, so you can move or delete a backup while Snippets is running
